Лайфхак для НМТ: спочатку прочитай питан: NMT life hack: read the question first, then the text. Underline the key words in the question, and look for their **synonyms** in the text, not the same words. An option that repeats a word from the text exactly is often a trap.
Дайте 6-7 хвилин на текст і питання без: Give 6-7 minutes for the text and questions without a dictionary, like in the exam. When checking, ask the student to point to the line in the text that proves the answer. For each wrong A-D option, briefly explain why it doesn’t fit.
Перше прослуховування: учень лише відпов: First listening: the student only says who is for the rule and who is against it. Second listening: they do the exercise. After checking, ask them to find phrases for agreeing and disagreeing in the dialogue (I see your point, That’s fair) and write them down for the speaking stage.
Як говорити про правила:\n\n**must / hav:
How to talk about rules:

**must / have to** = obligation (you need to)
**mustn’t / be not allowed to** = prohibition (you can’t)
**don’t have to** = no need (it’s not necessary)
**can / be allowed to** = permission (you may)

NMT trap: **don’t have to** does NOT mean prohibition. You don’t have to come = it’s fine if you don’t come.
Почніть з прикладів зі шкільних правил у: Start with examples from the student’s own school rules. Typical mistake: mustn’t instead of don’t have to. If the student mixes them up, draw a scale “prohibition → choice → obligation”. Check translations flexibly: accept synonymous answers manually.
Нам не можна користуватися телефонами на: We aren’t allowed to use phones in lessons
Тобі не обов’язково приходити завтра: You don’t have to come tomorrow
Учні мають залишати телефони в шафках: Students have to leave their phones in lockers
Попросіть учня в кожній відповіді вжити: Ask the student to use at least one structure from the language block and one phrase from the dialogue (I see your point, That’s fair) in each answer. Correct gently: repeat the sentence correctly and ask the student to repeat it.
Лист на НМТ: звертання (**Dear Mr Collin: NMT letter: greeting (**Dear Mr Collins,**) → one sentence on why you are writing → each point of the task in a separate paragraph → closing (**I hope you will consider my ideas.**) → signature. At least 50 words, all points are required.
На уроці учень складає план листа (2 хв): In class the student makes a plan of the letter (2 min) and writes the letter itself at home. Homework: write a letter of 50-70 words and learn the lesson words in the game. Finally, go back to the opinion scale from the Warm-up: has the student’s opinion changed?

**make** = створювати щось нове (make a:
**make** = to create something new (make a cake, make a mistake, make friends, make a decision).
**do** = to perform an action or work (do homework, do sport, do your best, do the shopping).

**say** something (say hello, say yes), but **tell** someone something (tell me, tell the truth, tell a story).
Пройдіться по списку слів і попросіть уч: Go through the word list and ask the student to make one sentence each with 3-4 expressions. There is a trap in the sorting: make a noise, make a phone call, do a favour. Discuss that these expressions simply need to be memorised.

зробити все можливе: to try as hard as you can
робити покупки: to buy food and things you need
позичати (у когось): to take something from someone and give it back later
**since** + момент (since Monday, since:
**since** + a point in time (since Monday, since 2018), **for** + a period (for two weeks, for an hour).

**borrow** = to take for a while (borrow FROM someone), **lend** = to give for a while (lend TO someone).

**remember** = to keep in your own mind, **remind** = to make someone else remember.

**lose** = to not be able to find, to be beaten; **miss** = to not catch or attend, to be late for, to feel sad without someone.
Попросіть учня до кожної пари придумати: Ask the student to come up with their own real-life example for each pair. Correct mistakes with questions: “Who gives the thing to whom?” for borrow/lend, “A point in time or a period?” for since/for.
Стратегія для тексту з пропусками: 1) пр: Strategy for a gapped text: 1) read the whole text to understand the meaning; 2) for each gap, decide what is being tested: grammar (tense, form) or vocabulary (meaning, set phrase); 3) put in your answer and check the words **before and after** the gap; 4) don’t leave any gaps empty.
Текст A учень виконує самостійно за 5 хв: The student does text A on their own in 5 minutes, text B in 5 minutes, then 5 minutes for review. When reviewing a mistake, ask them to name the type of gap (tense, preposition, word pair). Pay attention to time markers: last summer, since then, for two months.
Учень відповідає розгорнуто, 3-4 речення: The student gives full answers, 3-4 sentences per question. Your task: listen only for the pairs from the lesson. Note down mistakes and at the end of the stage take 1-2 minutes to correct them together.
Міні-тест учень виконує без підказок. Пе: The student does the mini test without hints. Check translations flexibly: manually accept correct answers that are not in the key. Homework: write 10 sentences of their own, two for each pair, and play the game with the lesson words.

Формат схожий на завдання НМТ, але текст: The format is similar to the NMT task, but the texts are our own. The lesson words appear in both texts. Typical traps here: make/do, for/since, say/tell, interested in. Ask the student to make sentences about themselves with 3 expressions.

НМТ Task 1: A new hobby · 15 хв: NMT Task 1: A new hobby · 15 min
Три типи пропусків:\n\n**Граматика:** ча:
Three types of gaps:

**Grammar:** tense or verb form (became / has become). Look for time markers: last month, for more than a year.
**Vocabulary:** the meaning of the word (take up / take after).
**Collocations and prepositions:** words that “go together” (interested in, make mistakes).
Дайте 6 хвилин на текст, як на іспиті. П: Give 6 minutes for the text, like in the exam. When checking, the student names the type of each gap. The for/since sorting is done after the text to reinforce the trap from gap 6.
Цей текст учень виконує на час: 4 хвилин: The student does this text against the clock: 4 minutes. Then check and review the traps: spend/pass time, look after, pay attention to. Remind them: if you don’t know the answer, rule out the clearly wrong options and choose from the ones left.
Інтерв’ю продовжує історію Макса з текст: The interview continues Max’s story from text 1. Listen twice. After the exercise, the student answers the questions using at least three expressions from the word list. Correct preposition mistakes immediately but briefly.
Міні-тест без підказок, 5 хвилин. Потім: Mini test without hints, 5 minutes. Then a summary: the student names three traps they remember. Homework: write their own 6-sentence text about hobbies with gaps and A-D options and swap it at the next lesson.

Прочитай абзац і сформулюй його головну: Read the paragraph and put its main idea into your own words. Only then look for the heading. Trap: a heading with the same word as in the text is often wrong. What matters is the meaning, not the words. In the NMT there are more headings than paragraphs, so some will be left over.
Дайте 7 хвилин на текст і заголовки. Тут: Give 7 minutes for the text and headings. There are already two extra headings here: “Teenagers who sleep too much” and “Why adults need less sleep”. After checking, discuss why they don’t fit any paragraph: the first contradicts the text, the second isn’t in the text at all.
НМТ Reading 2: Board games are back · 12: NMT Reading 2: Board games are back · 12 min
Заголовки НМТ майже завжди **перефразову: NMT headings almost always **paraphrase** the text. “Advice for beginners” may appear in the text as “If you want to start…”. Underline the phrase in the paragraph that proves your choice.
Цей текст учень виконує на час: 6 хвилин: The student does this text against the clock: 6 minutes. The extra headings here are: “Games that only adults can play” and “How to win every time”. The second one is deliberately similar to paragraph E: the paragraph says exactly the opposite (don’t worry about winning). The second exercise practises finding paraphrases.
Попросіть учня давати розгорнуті відпові: Ask the student to give full answers with arguments (because, for example). At the end, go back to the scale from the Warm-up: has their opinion about a later start to lessons changed after the text?
Міні-тест: три короткі абзаци, 4 хвилини: Mini test: three short paragraphs, 4 minutes. Then the student writes their own heading for paragraph 1 and explains the choice. Homework: find a short article in English (3-4 paragraphs), write a heading for each paragraph and one extra trap heading.

Розберемо структуру неформального листа:
Look at the structure of an informal letter in the NMT
Learn phrases for starting and ending a letter and for giving advice
Practise the linking words because, so, but, also
Write a letter of 50+ words that covers the three points of the task
Почніть з розмови про листування в житті: Start with a conversation about letters and messages in the student’s life. Discuss the statements about the task format: the student should explain each answer. The key message of this stage: all three points are required.
True or False? The NMT letter.
Неформальний лист: **Dear / Hi + ім’я,**: Informal letter: **Dear / Hi + name,** → introduction (say thank you or ask how they are) → the three points of the task, each in a separate paragraph → closing → **Best wishes / Love / Take care,** + your name. Make sure you cover all points of the task: you lose marks for each one you miss.
На НМТ лист оцінюють за змістом (усі пун: In the NMT, the letter is assessed on content (all points), structure, vocabulary and grammar. Go through the phrases and ask the student to choose 4 favourites to use in their own letter. The sorting is done independently.

Учень читає завдання і лист, потім знахо: The student reads the task and the letter, then finds where exactly each point is covered (they can underline them in different colours). Count the words together: the letter has about 90 words. Discuss what could be removed to make the letter shorter without losing any of the points.
Language focus: advice and linking words: Language focus: advice and linking words · 10 min
Порада і пропозиція: **You should + V**:
Advice and suggestions: **You should + V** (without to), **Why don’t we + V?**, **How about + V-ing?**, **Let’s + V**.

Linking words make the letter flow: **because** (reason), **so** (result), **but** (contrast), **also** (addition).
Типові помилки: should to, how about to: Typical mistakes: should to, how about to visit, why we don’t. Write the student’s mistakes on the board and ask them to correct them on their own. After the exercises, the student writes 2 pieces of advice of their own for a friend from abroad.
Діалог задає ситуацію для фінального лис: The dialogue sets up the situation for the final letter. After the exercise, the student plans the letter orally using the questions: one or two sentences per point. No writing yet, just speaking, so there is time left for writing.
Чекліст перед здачею: 1) усі три пункти: Checklist before handing in: 1) all three points are covered; 2) there is a greeting, introduction, closing and signature; 3) at least 50 words; 4) each point in a separate paragraph; 5) check should + V, tenses and articles.
Спершу 3 хвилини на вправу з помилками,: First 3 minutes for the error-correction exercise, then 10 minutes for the letter. Assess using the NMT criteria: content, structure, vocabulary, grammar. Homework: rewrite the letter taking the corrections into account and write another letter on the topic “Invite a friend to your birthday party” (50-70 words).

Прочитайте слова, звертаючи увагу на вим: Read the words, paying attention to the pronunciation of garment, sustainable, landfill. The student does match on their own, gap is checked together. Also ask: “What was your last impulse buy?”

Стратегія для A-D: спочатку прочитай пит: Strategy for A-D: first read the question without the options and find the right place in the text. Answer in your own words, and only then choose the option closest to your answer. Options with “never”, “always”, “all” are often too absolute.
Дайте 8 хвилин на текст і питання без сл: Give 8 minutes for the text and questions without a dictionary. When checking, the student quotes the line that proves the answer. Discuss the question about the designer’s quote: it tests understanding of hidden meaning, which often comes up in the NMT.
Перше прослуховування: учень відповідає,: First listening: the student says whether Tom agreed to come. Second listening: the exercise. After checking, discuss: are there clothes swaps or charity shops in your town?
Як аргументувати: **I’d argue that… / Th:
How to argue: **I’d argue that… / The main reason is… / On the other hand… / That’s why I believe…**

To disagree politely: **I see your point, but… / That’s true, however…**
Спершу учень відмічає шкалу, потім дебат: First the student marks the scale, then the debate: the student defends one position and the teacher the other, then you swap roles. Requirement: use at least 3 phrases from the tip. Note down mistakes and go over them in the last 2 minutes of the stage.
Структура opinion paragraph: 1) твоя дум: Opinion paragraph structure: 1) your opinion (**In my opinion…**); 2) first argument with an example; 3) second argument (**What is more…**); 4) a possible opposite view (**On the other hand…**); 5) conclusion (**To sum up…**).
На уроці учень виконує сортування і скла: In class the student does the sorting and makes a plan of the paragraph (5 min). Homework: write an opinion paragraph of 100-120 words using at least 4 words from the lesson and 3 linking words from the sorting. Extra: count the items in your wardrobe that haven’t been worn for over a year.
